items.title: Preview: LA Tech at Georgia Southern
items.summary: RUSTON -- With a Sun Belt Conference West Division title already secured and championship game hosting rights on the line, Louisiana Tech (9-2, 7-0 SBC) travels to Statesboro, Georgia, to close out the regular season against East Division leader Georgia Southern (7-4, 6-1 SBC) on Saturday. Kickoff from Allen E. Paulson Stadium is set for 11 a.m. CT on ESPNU.

items.title: Bulldogs Roll Past Arkansas State On Senior Day
items.summary: RUSTON -- Louisiana Tech continued its dominant run through Sun Belt Conference play Saturday night, cruising to a 48-3 victory over Arkansas State at Origin Bank Field at Joe Aillet Stadium to secure its first nine-win season since 2019 and finish undefeated at home for the first time in seven years.

items.title: Bulldogs Clinch Sun Belt West Division Title With 63-31 Victory Over Southern Miss
items.summary: RUSTON -- Louisiana Tech secured the Sun Belt Conference West Division championship in emphatic fashion Saturday afternoon, scoring a series-record 63 points and returning two interceptions for touchdowns in a 63-31 victory over Southern Miss at Joe Aillet Stadium.

items.title: Preview: LA Tech vs. Southern Miss
items.summary: RUSTON -- Louisiana Tech returns to Origin Bank Field at Joe Aillet Stadium on Saturday as the Bulldogs welcome longtime rival Southern Miss for a Sun Belt Conference showdown. The upcoming matchup will be the first time LA Tech and Southern Miss meet as conference opponents since the 2021 season.
